name: auto-model
description: Picks the model for each prompt and each subagent (never above /model and /effort for prompts), with Jev, OpenAI or Claude as the picker, and shows a colored bar under the input: model, effort, context, 7-day limit and agents. /auto-model on|off, /route for subagents. Subagent picking is ported from Hamza Zafar's switchboard (MIT).

picker.title: Picker
picker.description: Who picks the models. jev (TypeSafe's decision model, default) and openai (OpenAI's Decisions API) answer with a calibrated confidence and need their own key. claude asks Haiku through your Claude Code session: no extra key, nothing sent to a third party, but its confidence is its own rating and a pick takes longer.

style.title: Style
style.description: saver (default) picks the cheapest model that will do the work well. quality pays for the better model on anything you will rely on. Applies to prompts and subagents.

switchDownUntil.title: Switch down until
switchDownUntil.description: A cheaper model or a lower effort re-reads the whole conversation without the cache. Above this many context tokens the turn stays at the model and effort the last turn used (moving up is always allowed).

agents.title: Subagents
agents.description: auto switches a subagent that names no model to the one Jev picks. suggest only shows the pick in the band and /route. off leaves every subagent's model alone and sends Jev nothing about them.

agentModels.title: Subagent models
agentModels.description: The models Jev may pick between for a subagent, cheapest first.

keepNamed.title: Keep a named model
keepNamed.description: A subagent whose caller named a model keeps it. Turn off to have Jev pick for those too.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
jevApiKey.description: For the jev picker, at api.typesafe.ai. Empty uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: For the openai picker. Empty uses OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment.
